sources.title: Using El Capitan Systems: Hardware Overview
sources.titleEn: Using El Capitan Systems: Hardware Overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Arm SVE：向量長度無關的迴圈契約
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付共享物件圖、流量下限與同步版本測試；40/20毫秒下限重現，資料版本一致，流量與延遲證據分開；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver shared-object diagrams, traffic bounds and synchronization-version tests. Reproduce 40/20 ms bounds, match versions and separate traffic evidence from latency. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫37元素與不同lane群組；用不同顏色標出最後回合的無效位置；0.25/0.3125正確，37個結果逐項相同且尾端哨兵完好。
related.differenceEn: Draw 37 elements grouped at both widths, coloring inactive tail positions. Verify both fractions, identical 37 outputs and intact tail sentinels.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 讀取B bytes、有效頻寬b bytes/s時理想下限T=B/b；快取重用可減少B但需實際證據；合成B=24GB、b=600GB/s；重用後只讀12GB，使用十進位GB；名義式 24/600 = 0.04 s；變更式 12/600 = 0.02 s。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

有效元素總數等於完整回合×L+尾數，任何VL都應同一N；最後述詞僅啟用剩餘元素；合成N=37個FP32元素，VL128時L4，VL512時L16；求最後回合有效比例；名義式 1/4 = 0.25 active-lane fraction in final iteration；變更式 5/16 = 0.3125 active-lane fraction in final iteration。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Reading B bytes at effective bandwidth b gives lower bound T=B/b; cache reuse may reduce B but needs evidence. Synthetic B 24 GB, b 600 GB/s; reuse reduces reads to 12 GB, decimal GB. Nominal 24/600 = 0.04 s; changed 12/600 = 0.02 s. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Valid elements equal fullIterations×L+tail; every VL must cover the same N with only remaining lanes active. Synthetic N 37 FP32 values, L 4 at VL 128 and L 16 at VL 512; calculate final-iteration active fraction. Nominal 1/4 = 0.25 active-lane fraction in final iteration; changed 5/16 = 0.3125 active-lane fraction in final iteration. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenMP Target：資料映射的生命週期
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付共享物件圖、流量下限與同步版本測試；40/20毫秒下限重現，資料版本一致，流量與延遲證據分開；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver shared-object diagrams, traffic bounds and synchronization-version tests. Reproduce 40/20 ms bounds, match versions and separate traffic evidence from latency. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫主機變數、裝置映射、更新點與解除映射；明定to/from方向而非假設雙向同步；320/16帳目清楚，最後回傳與所有中間更新皆列入。
related.differenceEn: Draw host variables, device mappings, updates, and unmapping. State explicit to/from directions. Verify 320/16 while accounting for final retrieval and every intermediate update.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 讀取B bytes、有效頻寬b bytes/s時理想下限T=B/b；快取重用可減少B但需實際證據；合成B=24GB、b=600GB/s；重用後只讀12GB，使用十進位GB；名義式 24/600 = 0.04 s；變更式 12/600 = 0.02 s。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
每輪搬入搬出共D bytes，k輪重複映射流量kD；合法持續映射只有首入末出D；合成D=16MB，k=20；比較外層持續映射，輸入中途不由主機更改；名義式 20*(8+8) = 320 MB transferred；變更式 8+8 = 16 MB transferred。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Reading B bytes at effective bandwidth b gives lower bound T=B/b; cache reuse may reduce B but needs evidence. Synthetic B 24 GB, b 600 GB/s; reuse reduces reads to 12 GB, decimal GB. Nominal 24/600 = 0.04 s; changed 12/600 = 0.02 s. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

If round-trip traffic is D bytes, k repeated mappings cost kD, while legal persistent mapping costs D. Synthetic D 16 MB, k 20; compare outer persistent mapping with no intermediate host modifications. Nominal 20*(8+8) = 320 MB transferred; changed 8+8 = 16 MB transferred. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
